events.title: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026
events.eligibility: All ages, skill levels and professional backgrounds; check your selected local event's rules.
events.fee: Check the official local event page
events.description: Build solutions using NASA and partner open data. The official homepage announces November 14–15, 2026 and registration availability. This is a date-only calendar entry: actual start times, venue and submission cutoff depend on the selected local event. No global registration cutoff was verified.

events.title: Global Hack Week: Builders Week
events.eligibility: Students and working professionals; participants under 18 need a parent's permission under the registration terms.
events.description: A week of building, technical challenges, community sessions and workshops. November 6–12 is confirmed. Calendar dates are shown without exact session times because the registration page's EDT label needs clarification for November; check the organizer schedule before attending.

events.title: Global Hack Week: Open Source Week
events.eligibility: Students and working professionals; participants under 18 need a parent's permission under the registration terms.
events.description: Explore open source through technical challenges, livestreamed workshops and community mini-events. December 4–10 is confirmed. Calendar dates are shown without exact session times because the registration page's EDT label needs clarification for December; check the organizer schedule before attending.

events.title: Game Off 2026
events.eligibility: Individuals and teams; create a public GitHub repository and submit the game on itch.io.
events.fee: No entry fee listed; free accounts available
events.description: A November game jam with a theme revealed on November 1. Any programming language or game engine is welcome. Game submission closes December 1 at 13:37 PST. This is a submission cutoff, not a verified registration deadline.

events.title: GDevelop BIG Game Jam #10
events.eligibility: Use GDevelop; solo or teams of up to four. Publish a browser-playable game on both itch.io and gd.games.
events.fee: No entry fee listed; GDevelop is free and open source
events.description: Nine days to create a game using GDevelop, followed by community ratings and organizer judging. The theme is announced at the start. The end time is the game submission cutoff; no separate registration deadline was verified.

events.title: LÖVE Jam 2026 [B-SIDE]
events.eligibility: Solo or teams; game must run with an official version of the LÖVE framework. AI usage is prohibited by the organizer.
events.description: A ten-day online jam celebrating the LÖVE framework. An optional theme is revealed at the start. Games must be made during the jam; pre-made assets require credits. The end time is a submission cutoff, not a registration deadline.

events.title: Metroidvania Month Finale
events.eligibility: Full rules and eligibility are still to be announced on the official jam page.
events.description: A month-long online jam focused on creating a metroidvania game. Submission dates are confirmed, while detailed rules remain unpublished. Recheck the official page before committing. No separate registration deadline was verified.

events.title: hackCBS 9.0
events.organizer: hackCBS at Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies
events.eligibility: Students only, including international and high-school students; student ID required. Teams of two to four; under-18s need parental consent.
events.description: A student hackathon at Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies on October 31–November 1. Beginners are welcome and teams are shortlisted from applications. Dates are confirmed by the organizer and MLH; exact daily times and an unambiguous registration cutoff were not verified. Check the official website before arranging travel.

events.title: Junction 2026: European Tech Renaissance
events.eligibility: International and Finnish builders, designers, engineers and problem solvers. Teams of one to four; application and acceptance required.
events.description: A 48-hour hackathon at Hype Arena in Espoo on November 13–15. The organizer lists registration as open with an October 25 cutoff, but its UTC+03:00 schedule label conflicts with Finland's November timezone. This entry therefore uses dates only and leaves the precise deadline unset. International travel-grant applications are already closed.

events.title: HackTheBurgh XIII
events.eligibility: Age 18 or older; current university students or graduates within the past year, from any degree discipline. Teams of up to four; accepted applicants only.
events.description: A student-led hackathon at the Nucleus Building, Edinburgh. Applications are closed: the official application deadline was October 10 at 23:59 BST. The event remains upcoming for accepted attendees. Registration opens onsite at 10:00 on November 7; project submissions close at noon on November 8. Event times use Edinburgh local time.

events.title: ICPC Asia Dhaka Regional 2026
events.organizer: IUBAT School of Computer Science and Engineering / ICPC
events.eligibility: University teams of three from the same institution; official ICPC eligibility rules apply.
events.fee: Organizer says registration is free; a participation fee may apply. Verify the announcement.
events.description: IUBAT announces an online preliminary and onsite regional contest. Exact dates need clarification: its homepage lists the final on December 19, while its schedule lists December 20, and the ICPC registry has a different registration range. Dates and deadlines are deliberately unset until these official sources agree. Open the organizer website for updates.
